title: split button dont repeat primary
name: Split button: don't repeat primary
rule: Split button: full phrase on the rest-state primary; don’t repeat that primary in the secondary list.
pass_when: Rest-state primary has the full phrase; the secondary list does not repeat that primary.
fail_when: Primary phrase is incomplete, or the same primary is duplicated in the list.
overview: Split-button primary shows the full phrase; the menu does not repeat it.
apply_when: Composing a Fluent split button with a primary and secondary list.
not_when: Ordinary button groups without a split primary-plus-menu pattern.
agent_hint: Put the full primary phrase on rest-state; do not duplicate it in the list.
description: A Fluent split button puts the full phrase on the rest-state primary so the default action is clear before the menu opens. The secondary list must not repeat that same primary entry. Apply when composing a split button with a primary action and overflow list. Fail an incomplete primary phrase, or the same primary duplicated inside the secondary list.
